450	    /// Move an object to a new zone.
451	    /// Per MTG rules, changing zones makes it a "new object" — we increment zone_change_count.
452	    pub fn move_object(&mut self, id: ObjectId, to: Zone) {
453	        // Collect log info before mutating.
454	        let log_msg = self.objects.get(&id).and_then(|obj| {
455	            if obj.zone == Zone::Battlefield && to != Zone::Battlefield && obj.power.is_some() {
456	                let dest = match to {
457	                    Zone::Graveyard => "died",
458	                    Zone::Exile => "was exiled",
459	                    _ => "left the battlefield",
460	                };
461	                Some(format!("{} {}", obj.name, dest))
462	            } else {
463	                None
464	            }
465	        });
466	
467	        if let Some(msg) = log_msg {
468	            self.log(LogLevel::Event, msg);
469	        }
470	
471	        let from = self.objects.get(&id).map(|o| o.zone);
472	
473	        if let Some(obj) = self.objects.get_mut(&id) {
474	            let from = obj.zone;
475	            obj.zone = to;
476	            obj.zone_change_count += 1;
477	
478	            // Reset battlefield-specific state when leaving the battlefield.
479	            if from == Zone::Battlefield && to != Zone::Battlefield {
480	                obj.tapped = false;
481	                obj.summoning_sick = false;
482	                obj.damage_marked = 0;
483	                obj.dealt_deathtouch_damage = false; obj.damaged_by.clear();
484	                obj.attached_to = None;
485	                obj.counters.clear();
486	                obj.regeneration_shields = 0;
487	            }
488	
489	            // Set summoning sickness when entering the battlefield.
490	            if to == Zone::Battlefield && from != Zone::Battlefield {
491	                obj.summoning_sick = true;
492	            }
493	        }
494	
495	        // Emit zone-change events outside the mutable borrow.
496	        if let Some(from_zone) = from {
497	            if from_zone == Zone::Battlefield && to != Zone::Battlefield {
498	                self.events.push(crate::events::GameEvent::LeftBattlefield {
499	                    object: id,
500	                    to,
501	                });
502	            }
503	            if to == Zone::Battlefield && from_zone != Zone::Battlefield {
504	                // Apply entering-battlefield replacement effects (CR 614.1d).
505	                // If a permanent with entering_copy_source is on the battlefield
506	                // under the same controller, the entering creature becomes a copy
507	                // of that source before it officially "enters."
508	                self.apply_entering_copy_replacement(id);
509	
510	                let controller = self.get_object(id).map(|o| o.controller).unwrap_or(PlayerId(0));
511	                self.events.push(crate::events::GameEvent::EnteredBattlefield {
512	                    object: id,
513	                    controller,
514	                });
515	            }
516	        }
517	    }

519	    /// Apply entering-battlefield copy replacement effects (CR 614.1d).
520	    /// If any permanent with `entering_copy_source` is on the battlefield under the
521	    /// same controller as `entering_id`, the entering creature's characteristics are
522	    /// replaced with those of the copy source. The entering creature keeps its own
523	    /// identity (ObjectId, owner, controller) but gains the source's copiable values.
524	    fn apply_entering_copy_replacement(&mut self, entering_id: ObjectId) {
525	        // Get the entering creature's controller and check it's a creature.
526	        let (controller, is_creature) = match self.get_object(entering_id) {
527	            Some(o) => (o.controller, o.power.is_some()),
528	            None => return,
529	        };
530	        if !is_creature {
531	            return;
532	        }
533	
534	        // Find a copy source on the battlefield under the same controller.
535	        // The entering creature itself cannot be its own copy source.
536	        let source_data: Option<(String, i32, i32, Vec<crate::types::Color>, Vec<crate::types::CardType>, Vec<String>, Vec<crate::types::Keyword>, String, bool)> = self.objects.values()
537	            .find(|o| {
538	                o.zone == Zone::Battlefield
539	                    && o.controller == controller
540	                    && o.entering_copy_source
541	                    && o.id != entering_id
542	            })
543	            .map(|source| {
544	                (
545	                    source.name.clone(),
546	                    source.power.unwrap_or(0),
547	                    source.toughness.unwrap_or(0),
548	                    source.colors.clone(),
549	                    source.card_types.clone(),
550	                    source.subtypes.clone(),
551	                    source.keywords.clone(),
552	                    source.instance_oracle_text.clone()
553	                        .unwrap_or_else(|| String::new()),
554	                    source.entering_copy_source,
555	                )
556	            });
557	
558	        if let Some((name, power, toughness, colors, card_types, subtypes, keywords, oracle_text, entering_copy_source)) = source_data {
559	            let old_name = self.get_object(entering_id).map(|o| o.name.clone()).unwrap_or_default();
560	            if let Some(obj) = self.get_object_mut(entering_id) {
561	                obj.name = name.clone();
562	                obj.power = Some(power);
563	                obj.toughness = Some(toughness);
564	                obj.colors = colors;
565	                obj.card_types = card_types;
566	                obj.subtypes = subtypes;
567	                obj.keywords = keywords;
568	                obj.instance_continuous_effects = Some(vec![]);
569	                obj.instance_oracle_text = Some(oracle_text);
570	                obj.entering_copy_source = entering_copy_source;
571	            }
572	            self.log(LogLevel::Event,
573	                format!("{} enters as a copy of {} ({}/{})", old_name, name, power, toughness));
574	        }
575	    }

636	    /// Check if a creature matches a CreatureFilter, evaluated from the perspective
637	    /// of the effect's source permanent.
638	    pub fn matches_filter(
639	        &self,
640	        creature_id: ObjectId,
641	        filter: &crate::types::CreatureFilter,
642	        source_controller: PlayerId,
643	        registry: &crate::cards::CardRegistry,
644	    ) -> bool {
645	        use crate::types::CreatureFilter;
646	        let creature = match self.get_object(creature_id) {
647	            Some(o) => o,
648	            None => return false,
649	        };
650	        match filter {
651	            CreatureFilter::You => creature.controller == source_controller,
652	            CreatureFilter::Opponents => creature.controller != source_controller,
653	            CreatureFilter::YourTokens => creature.controller == source_controller && creature.is_token,
654	            CreatureFilter::HasSubtype(subtype) => {
655	                // For transformed DFCs, use back face subtypes instead of front face.
656	                if creature.is_transformed {
657	                    if let Some(behavior) = registry.get(creature.card_id) {
658	                        if let Some(back) = behavior.back_face_data() {
659	                            if back.subtypes.iter().any(|s| s == subtype) {
660	                                return true;
661	                            }
662	                        }
663	                    }
664	                } else {
665	                    // Check card data subtypes first, then object-level subtypes (for tokens).
666	                    if registry.card_data(creature.card_id)
667	                        .map(|d| d.subtypes.iter().any(|s| s == subtype))
668	                        .unwrap_or(false) {
669	                        return true;
670	                    }
671	                }
672	                creature.subtypes.iter().any(|s| s == subtype)
673	            }
674	            CreatureFilter::HasKeyword(kw) => self.has_keyword(creature_id, *kw, registry),
675	            CreatureFilter::And(filters) => filters.iter().all(|f| self.matches_filter(creature_id, f, source_controller, registry)),
676	            CreatureFilter::Or(filters) => filters.iter().any(|f| self.matches_filter(creature_id, f, source_controller, registry)),
677	            CreatureFilter::Not(inner) => !self.matches_filter(creature_id, inner, source_controller, registry),
678	            CreatureFilter::AttachedPlayer => {
679	                // This filter requires knowing the source object's attached_to_player.
680	                // It's resolved in effect_applies_to which has source_id.
681	                // If called directly from matches_filter without source context,
682	                // fall back to Opponents (the common case for curses).
683	                creature.controller != source_controller
684	            }
685	        }
686	    }

688	    /// Check if a continuous effect applies to a given creature.
689	    pub fn effect_applies_to(
690	        &self,
691	        creature_id: ObjectId,
692	        scope: &crate::types::EffectScope,
693	        source_id: ObjectId,
694	        source_controller: PlayerId,
695	        registry: &crate::cards::CardRegistry,
696	    ) -> bool {
697	        use crate::types::EffectScope;
698	        match scope {
699	            EffectScope::OnSelf => creature_id == source_id,
700	            EffectScope::Attached => {
701	                self.get_object(source_id)
702	                    .and_then(|o| o.attached_to)
703	                    .map(|target| target == creature_id)
704	                    .unwrap_or(false)
705	            }
706	            EffectScope::Global(filter) => {
707	                // For AttachedPlayer filter, use the source's attached_to_player.
708	                if matches!(filter, crate::types::CreatureFilter::AttachedPlayer) {
709	                    let attached_player = self.get_object(source_id)
710	                        .and_then(|o| o.attached_to_player);
711	                    if let Some(player) = attached_player {
712	                        let creature = self.get_object(creature_id);
713	                        return creature.map(|c| c.controller == player).unwrap_or(false);
714	                    }
715	                    return false;
716	                }
717	                self.matches_filter(creature_id, filter, source_controller, registry)
718	            }
719	            EffectScope::GlobalOther(filter) => {
720	                creature_id != source_id && self.matches_filter(creature_id, filter, source_controller, registry)
721	            }
722	        }
723	    }

725	    /// Collect all (power_mod, toughness_mod) from continuous effects that apply to a creature.
726	    fn continuous_pt_mods(&self, creature_id: ObjectId, registry: &crate::cards::CardRegistry) -> (i32, i32) {
727	        use crate::types::ContinuousEffect;
728	        let mut power = 0;
729	        let mut toughness = 0;
730	        for source in self.objects.values() {
731	            if source.zone != Zone::Battlefield {
732	                continue;
733	            }
734	            // Check instance-level effects first (e.g., Bonds of Faith).
735	            if let Some(ref instance_effects) = source.instance_continuous_effects {
736	                for effect in instance_effects {
737	                    if let ContinuousEffect::ModifyPT { power: p, toughness: t, scope } = effect {
738	                        if self.effect_applies_to(creature_id, scope, source.id, source.controller, registry) {
739	                            power += p;
740	                            toughness += t;
741	                        }
742	                    }
743	                }
744	            } else if let Some(behavior) = registry.get(source.card_id) {
745	                // Card-level static effects (use back face if transformed).
746	                let effects = if source.is_transformed {
747	                    behavior.back_face_data().map(|d| d.continuous_effects).unwrap_or_default()
748	                } else {
749	                    behavior.card_data().continuous_effects
750	                };
751	                for effect in &effects {
752	                    if let ContinuousEffect::ModifyPT { power: p, toughness: t, scope } = effect {
753	                        if self.effect_applies_to(creature_id, scope, source.id, source.controller, registry) {
754	                            power += p;
755	                            toughness += t;
756	                        }
757	                    }
758	                }
759	                // Dynamic P/T from auras (e.g., Wreath of Geists: +X/+X where X = creatures in graveyard).
760	                if source.attached_to == Some(creature_id) {
761	                    if let Some((p, t)) = behavior.dynamic_pt(self, source.id) {
762	                        power += p;
763	                        toughness += t;
764	                    }
765	                }
766	            }
767	        }
768	        (power, toughness)
769	    }

1011	                }
1012	            } else if behavior.card_data().keywords.contains(&keyword) {

1021	                ContinuousEffect::GrantKeyword { keyword: kw, scope } if *kw == keyword => Some(scope),
1022	                _ => None,

1024	        }, registry);

1031	        if has_conditional {

1080	    /// Evaluate an EffectCondition for a given controller.
1081	    fn check_condition(&self, condition: &crate::types::EffectCondition, source_id: ObjectId, controller: crate::ids::PlayerId, registry: &crate::cards::CardRegistry) -> bool {
1082	        use crate::types::EffectCondition;
1083	        match condition {
1084	            EffectCondition::YouControlSubtype(subtype) => {
1085	                self.objects.values().any(|o| {
1086	                    o.zone == Zone::Battlefield && o.controller == controller && (
1087	                        o.subtypes.iter().any(|s| s == subtype)
1088	                        || registry.card_data(o.card_id)
1089	                            .map(|d| d.subtypes.iter().any(|s| s == subtype))
1090	                            .unwrap_or(false)
1091	                    )
1092	                })
1093	            }
1094	            EffectCondition::OpponentControlsSubtype(subtype) => {
1095	                let opponent = self.opponent(controller);
1096	                self.objects.values().any(|o| {
1097	                    o.zone == Zone::Battlefield && o.controller == opponent && (
1098	                        o.subtypes.iter().any(|s| s == subtype)
1099	                        || registry.card_data(o.card_id)
1100	                            .map(|d| d.subtypes.iter().any(|s| s == subtype))
1101	                            .unwrap_or(false)
1102	                    )
1103	                })
1104	            }
1105	            EffectCondition::SelfHasKeyword(kw) => {
1106	                // Check if the source permanent has the specified keyword.
1107	                // Careful: don't recurse if checking indestructible conditioned on defender —
1108	                // we check base keywords directly to avoid infinite recursion.
1109	                self.get_object(source_id)
1110	                    .map(|o| {
1111	                        // Check object-level keywords.
1112	                        if o.keywords.contains(kw) {
1113	                            // But also check if it was temporarily removed.
1114	                            !self.until_end_of_turn_removed_keywords.iter()
1115	                                .any(|r| r.target == source_id && r.keyword == *kw)
1116	                        } else {
1117	                            // Check card_data keywords.
1118	                            registry.card_data(o.card_id)
1119	                                .map(|d| d.keywords.contains(kw))
1120	                                .unwrap_or(false)
1121	                                && !self.until_end_of_turn_removed_keywords.iter()
1122	                                    .any(|r| r.target == source_id && r.keyword == *kw)
1123	                        }
1124	                    })
1125	                    .unwrap_or(false)
1126	            }
1127	        }
1128	    }

## Audit Summary: Isolated Chapel

**Status: ISSUE**

### Root Cause

`controller_has_matching_land` (lines 21–23 of `isolated_chapel.rs`) checks only `o.subtypes` on game objects to detect Plains and Swamp:

```rust
o.subtypes.iter().any(|s| s == "Plains")
    || o.subtypes.iter().any(|s| s == "Swamp")
```

However, `setup_game` in `engine.rs` (lines 2669–2683) **never populates `obj.subtypes` from card data** for regular deck cards — it copies `keywords`, `card_types`, `colors`, and `name`, but not `subtypes`. The `PlayLand` handler also doesn't populate subtypes. As a result, a Plains or Swamp played from a real deck always has `obj.subtypes = []`, the match fails, and **Isolated Chapel always enters tapped** even when you control a Plains or Swamp.

This contrasts with `check_condition` in `state.rs` (lines 1086–1092) which correctly checks both `o.subtypes` AND `registry.card_data(o.card_id).subtypes`. The card's `on_enter_battlefield` receives the registry as `_registry` (unused), and `controller_has_matching_land` takes no registry parameter at all.

### Test Situation

Existing tests for sibling cards (Clifftop Retreat's "enters untapped with Mountain" test, Woodland Cemetery's "enters untapped with Swamp" test) both **manually inject** `obj.subtypes` to work around the bug, so they pass despite the underlying problem. No test exercises Isolated Chapel's untapped entry condition at all.
